name: final-health
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts health run --changed --source eslint,typescript

name: final-types
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run typecheck

name: final-script-types
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run typecheck:scripts

name: final-backend-lint
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src/hub src/remote-control src/remote src/commands/hub.ts src/commands/hub-machine.ts src/commands/hub-machine.test.ts scripts/package-team-hub.ts scripts/package-team-hub.test.ts scripts/build-hub-web.ts scripts/build-hub-web.test.ts

name: final-backend-tests
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test src/hub/ src/remote-control/ src/remote/ src/commands/hub-machine.test.ts src/cli-reference-coverage.test.ts src/standard/commands-by-task.test.ts src/standard/help-groups.test.ts

name: final-packaging-tests
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test scripts/package-team-hub.test.ts

name: final-frontend-tests
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run --cwd apps/hub-web test

name: final-frontend-types
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run --cwd apps/hub-web typecheck

name: final-frontend-lint
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run --cwd apps/hub-web lint

name: final-frontend-build
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run --cwd apps/hub-web build

name: final-embedded-assets
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun scripts/build-hub-web.ts --check
